cohiba-cuba--behike.description: Launched in Havana in 2010 as the most exclusive line Habanos makes, Behike is the first Cohiba to blend in medio tiempo: a rare leaf from the very top of the sun-grown plant. It brings concentrated character and aroma, and its scarcity keeps each year's production small.

thirds.notes: Earth and wood with a touch of spice, in a creamy, generous smoke from the first draw.
Creamy cocoa and leather deepen the blend, with hints of espresso.
Spice returns over dark chocolate, roasted coffee and nuts for a long, rich finish.

cohiba-cuba--linea-clasica.description: The original Cohiba range, built up between 1966 and 1989 and rolled at the El Laguito factory in Havana from Vuelta Abajo leaf. Cohiba is the only Habanos brand that gives two of its leaf types an extra fermentation. Medium to full, it moves from coffee and wood through leather and cocoa to a peppery, dark-chocolate close.

thirds.notes: Coffee, wood and earth with a hint of cedar and cocoa, and a light spice on a creamy smoke.
Leather and cocoa come forward over an earthy base, with a gentle sweetness and softer spice.
Dark chocolate, leather and earth build to a firmer finish with peppery spice.

cohiba-cuba--linea-1492.description: Launched in 1992 to mark five centuries since Columbus reached Cuba, Línea 1492 is the medium-strength side of Cohiba, from the small Siglo I to the Siglo VI and Medio Siglo. Made by hand in Havana, it opens creamy with cocoa and coffee, then builds cedar, leather and spice towards a sweet, peppery finish.

thirds.notes: A smooth, creamy start with cocoa and coffee, a delicate spice and a light honeyed sweetness.
Flavours deepen into cedar and leather with a bolder coffee and rising spice.
Sweetness and dark chocolate grow, with leather, earth and pepper on the finish.

cohiba-cuba--maduro-5.description: Introduced in 2007, the Maduro 5 line uses a wrapper aged for five years through natural processes, which gives it a darker colour and deeper character than other Cohibas. It launched with three vitolas, Genios, Mágicos and Secretos, and Habanos rates it medium to full.

thirds.notes: Dark cocoa and aged wood open the smoke, with roasted coffee, earth and a lively edge of spice.
Cocoa takes the lead and turns richer, while the spice grows bolder over a creamier texture.
Earth, black pepper and leather come forward; a faint honeyed sweetness remains as the intensity peaks.

cohiba-cuba--linea-clasica-stopgezet.description: This entry gathers Cohiba Línea Clásica sizes that have left the regular catalogue, such as the Coronas. They were made at El Laguito in Havana with the same Vuelta Abajo leaf and extra fermentation as the current Clásica, and are now found only as aged boxes.

cohiba-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Cohiba's Edición Limitada releases appear in small quantities in sizes the brand does not normally make, from the Pirámides of 2001 to the 55 Aniversario Victoria of 2021. Habanos makes Limited Editions with tobacco aged at least two years, and each box and cigar carries an extra band with the year of release.

cohiba-cuba--reserva-en-gran-reserva.description: Cohiba was the first Habanos brand to release a Reserva, in 2002, and a Gran Reserva, in 2009, made from leaf aged at least three and five years respectively. The first Gran Reserva was a Siglo VI from the 2003 harvest; later releases include a Robusto Reserva and Espléndidos Gran Reserva.

cohiba-cuba--coleccion-habanos-en-specia.description: Cohiba is often chosen for Habanos' special productions: very limited releases such as the Colección Habanos book-shaped cabinets, anniversary humidors and specialist exclusives. Examples range from the 1994 Torpedo and Gran Corona to the Majestuoso 1966 and the 2024 Vistosos. These come in small, one-time runs.
